      Frequently Asked Questions

      Orient Electric: Trusted Electrical & Home Appliances ▾

      For over 65 years, Orient Electric has been part of everyday life in India, building expertise across fans, lighting, water heaters, air coolers, home and kitchen appliances, switches, switchgear and wires. From energy-efficient BLDC ceiling fans and LED lighting to water heating and practical kitchen appliances, the brand brings together technology, design and dependable performance for everyday use. Whether you are improving a living room, setting up a kitchen, upgrading electrical fittings or looking for better energy efficiency, Orient Electric offers products across the spaces and routines that matter at home.

      About Orient Electric

      We're Orient Electric, part of the CKA Birla Group, with a presence in more than 30 countries today. Across India, you'll find us in over 1,25,000 retail outlets, backed by a service network that reaches more than 450 cities, so support is rarely far from wherever you live. We're also India's largest exporter of fans, built on the same reliability we bring to everything else we make, from lighting to water heaters and the rest of our home appliance range.

      A home may need a ceiling fan for everyday cooling, LED lights for different rooms, a water heater for the bathroom, a mixer grinder for the kitchen and switches and protection devices for the electrical system. Orient Electric serves these different requirements through products built around everyday use, energy efficiency, design, convenience and safety.

      Electrical Products for the Way Homes Work

      A home today needs more than a few individual appliances. Cooling, lighting, hot water, cooking, personal comfort and electrical safety all contribute to how a household functions.

      Orient Electric's product portfolio reflects this everyday ecosystem.

      Fans for Everyday Cooling

      Fans remain an important part of home comfort across India. Orient Electric offers ceiling fans along with BLDC ceiling fans, decorative fans, wall fans, pedestal or stand fans, table fans, exhaust fans and personal fans.

      The range covers different room sizes, installation requirements, and usage preferences. BLDC fan technology also brings energy efficiency into an everyday appliance that may run for several hours a day. Products such as remote-controlled and anti-dust fan models add convenience for customers looking for specific features rather than a one-size-fits-all solution.

      Lighting for Different Spaces

      Lighting influences both visibility and the character of a room. Orient Electric's lighting portfolio includes LED bulbs, ceiling lights, wall lights, outdoor lights, decorative lights and table lamps.

      Different spaces call for different lighting approaches. A living room may need broad illumination, a study may benefit from focused task lighting, while outdoor areas may require lighting built for exterior use. By organizing lighting around product types as well as spaces, customers can find products that fit the way they use their homes.

      Water Heaters (Geysers) for Everyday Hot Water

      Water heating is another important part of home comfort, particularly during colder months. Orient Electric offers storage water geysers, instant water geysers and immersion rods across different applications.

      Storage water heaters can suit households that need hot water for regular bathing and multiple users, while instant water heaters are useful where hot water is required quickly and in smaller quantities. Immersion water heaters offer a practical option for specific heating requirements.

      Rather than choosing only on capacity, customers should consider factors such as household size, installation location, usage pattern, safety features, energy rating and water conditions.

      Home and Kitchen Appliances

      Everyday appliances can make routine household tasks simpler, from preparing food to caring for clothes and maintaining comfort through different seasons.

      Orient Electric's small appliance portfolio includes mixer grinders, juicer mixer grinders, irons, coffee machines, kitchen machines, induction cooktops, electric kettles and room heaters. These products serve practical use cases across kitchens, bedrooms, living spaces and everyday household routines.

      Mixer grinders and juicer mixer grinders support regular food preparation, while electric kettles can be useful for quickly preparing hot beverages and water. Dry and steam irons address different fabric-care requirements, while room heaters provide seasonal warmth when temperatures fall.

      Air Coolers for Seasonal Comfort

      Air coolers offer another approach to cooling, particularly in regions and conditions where evaporative cooling is suitable. Orient Electric's range includes desert coolers, window coolers, personal coolers, tower coolers and larger cooling solutions.

      The right type depends on factors such as room size, ventilation, climate, portability and expected usage. A compact personal cooler can suit a smaller space, while a desert cooler can be considered for larger areas where stronger air delivery is required.

      Energy-Efficient Innovation

      Energy consumption has become an important consideration when buying everyday electrical products. An appliance that operates for several hours a day can have a meaningful impact on household electricity use over time.

      Orient Electric has developed products around technologies and features that address efficiency and convenience. BLDC motors in fans are one example. Compared with conventional fan motors, BLDC technology can reduce power consumption while also supporting quieter operation in suitable models.

      Energy efficiency also extends to lighting and appliances. Customers can compare energy ratings, wattage, operating modes and usage requirements rather than looking only at the purchase price.

      The objective is simple: help customers choose electrical products that make sense not just when they buy them, but throughout their everyday use.

      Smart Solutions for Everyday Living

      Technology is changing the role of everyday electrical products. Remote controls, smart connectivity, programmable settings, sensors and other features can make products easier to operate and more suited to individual routines.

      Orient Electric's portfolio includes products that bring technology into familiar categories. Smart and connected features can be particularly useful where users want greater control over lighting, cooling or other household functions. At the same time, useful feature that makes an appliance easier to operate, more convenient to manage or better suited to the way a customer uses it.

      Quality, Safety and Product Reliability

      Electrical products are part of the infrastructure of a home, so quality and safety cannot be treated as secondary considerations.

      Customers should look at construction, electrical protection, applicable standards, warranties, installation requirements and after-sales support when comparing products.

      Orient Electric's portfolio spans both consumer appliances and electrical products such as switches, switchgear and wiring. This gives the brand a broader role in the home than a company focused on a single appliance category.

      For products where applicable, customers should also check the relevant certification and product documentation before purchase and installation. Product-specific claims, ratings and certifications should always be verified against the individual products and documentation.

      Design

      Electrical products are increasingly visible parts of a home's interior. Fans, lights, switches and appliances need to perform their function while fitting into the spaces where people live.

      Orient Electric's portfolio combines functional products with design-focused ranges across fans, lighting and appliances. From decorative ceiling fans and contemporary lighting to compact kitchen appliances, the focus is on bringing modern designs, colors, useful technology into products that work naturally within modern Indian homes.

      This approach also gives customers more choice. A product can be selected for airflow, energy consumption, capacity, convenience, appearance or a combination of these factors depending on the application.

      Customer Support, Warranty and Service

      The relationship between an appliance brand and its customer does not end when a product is purchased.

      Installation, warranty registration, service requests, product information and access to support are important parts of ownership. Orient Electric provides customer-facing resources for warranty registration, contact and service support, alongside its wider service network.

      For customers buying electrical appliances, this type of support infrastructure can be an important consideration alongside product specifications and price.

      Before purchasing, customers should review the warranty terms and installation requirements applicable to the specific product.

      Explore: Register Warranty | Contact Orient Electric

      Shopping with Confidence

      Buying an electrical appliance is not only about finding the lowest price. The more useful comparison considers the product's intended use, capacity, energy consumption, features, installation requirements, warranty and support and here at OEL you can find your appliances partner.

      Orient Electric's online store allows customers to browse products across fans, lighting, water heaters, air coolers, small appliances, switchgear and wires.
